layout.reason: The poster uses a very clean and structured three-column grid with clearly separated sections and consistent headers.

readability.reason: The poster is extremely crowded with large walls of text and numerous dense tables, making the text size very small and difficult to read from a normal viewing distance.

fidelity.reason: The poster is highly faithful to the paper, accurately presenting the methodology (AOG, OCA, REG), dataset details (656 patients), and all primary and secondary staging results.

holistic.reason: While the layout is well-structured and the content is highly faithful to the paper, the poster suffers from extreme text density and crowded blocks, making it function more like a 'paper on a wall' than an easily readable presentation.
